title: Sign in with password and TOTP
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/admin-signin.e2e.ts.

steps.title: Open a console page while signed out
Password step
steps.expect: Redirect to `/sign-in/mfa?next=/tenants`; only `__Host-vxa_mfa` is set. A non-admin or wrong password shows 'The e-mail address or password is not correct, or the account is not an active platform admin.'

steps.title: Code step
steps.body: Type the 6-digit **Authentication code** and press **Verify and sign in** (or **Use a recovery code instead**).
steps.expect: Back on `/tenants`; `__Host-vxa_at` and `__Host-vxa_rt` HttpOnly + Secure; audit row `admin.sign_in`. A wrong code shows 'The code is not correct.' at the field.

steps.title: Sign out
steps.expect: `/sign-in?signedOut=1` with 'You are signed out.'; cookies gone; the next sign-in asks for a code again.
